summary.note: Bounded 30-run sweep 2026-06-12 (22:41-22:47 UTC, 350.2s, all 30 rc=0, no crashes/tracebacks in this run's log segment; the InvalidPasswordError strings a grep surfaced from autoresearch_loop.log are stale entries from the 2026-06-11 cross-venue-basis-v1 crashed sweep at commit c1525eb, lines 73-2335, all preceding this run which starts at line 12147 and loaded real data 1417-1489 pts/window). 30 dislocation_event_rolling_entry candidates (rolling-threshold variant: metric basis/premium, tail 5/10, horizon 12/24, rolling_days 90, cooldown==horizon, time-stop exit). 0/30 passed the standard gate. The rolling variant ELIMINATED the v0 sparsity failure: trade counts 134-289 and WFO trade counts ~66 (vs v0's 7-20 and the min-20 gate). But with adequate frequency the thin per-event edge collapses under engine realism: full-period in-engine return is NEGATIVE in 30/30 (range -74.7% to -16.3%; best basis_spread tail5 h24: -16.3%, win 51%, sharpe -0.05), and WFO returns are -15.3% to -54.8% with bootstrap P(loss) 67-99%. The probe's net medians (+0.03 to +0.12% at 51-53% win, flat 0.10% cost, clean horizon exit) did not survive ATR sizing + the executor exit model (SL/TP/trailing/time-stop) + real fees. Anti-inertness verified: returns/trades/gates vary monotonically with tail and horizon. Win rates ~51% match the probe (50.8-52.9%), confirming the strategy fires on the correct events; the edge magnitude, not the event detection, is the failure.
